other_conditions: The applicant must be enrolled with the Employment Bank as a job seeker
The applicant must have at least an 8th‑standard education
The applicant must not have previously availed financial assistance or loan under any state or central government self‑employment scheme
Only one member of a family is eligible to receive assistance
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹1500 per month along with job‑search support, skill‑training programmes, and placement assistance.
